name: people
description: Employees as recorded now, one row each, including leavers and inactive records: subsidiary, pillar, manager, role, whether a contractor, whether active, work calendar and hourly labour cost. NetSuite keeps no history of these fields.

pillar.label: department_name
pillar.description: The employee's department, which is their practice pillar.

manager.label: manager_name
manager.description: The resource or practice manager (NetSuite supervisor).

role.description: Job title, e.g. Senior Consultant, BC Developer.

active.description: T while the employee record is active.

work_calendar.label: calendar_name
work_calendar.description: The work calendar that sets the person's working days, hours and public holidays.

cost_currency.description: The currency of the employee's subsidiary, which their labour cost is in.

labour_cost.description: Hourly labour cost; missing for some people.
